[[File:TzHaar-Mej chathead.png|left|100px]]
The '''TzHaar-Mej''' inhabit the [[TzHaar city]]. They can be found wielding a [[Toktz-Mej-Tal]]. They attack slightly slower than other TzHaar, but they can use powerful magic that hits quite hard, although they may sometimes close in to use melee. In addition, when attacked, they may on rare occasions call for help ({{RSChat|Kot kl, zek e JalYt!}}, which roughly translates into "Save me, attack the human!") which will cause any nearby [[TzHaar-Ket]] or [[TzHaar-Xil]] to attack you.

TzHaar-Mej can use two types of attacks. These include a melee attack with its staff, and a stronger magic attack that can deal considerable damage (800+). It may be advisable to activate [[Protect from Magic]] to reduce damage from the magic attack.
